title: Checkout: discount codes and payment retries
overview: Adds optional discount codes to checkout; the response now returns subtotal, discount and total.
Contract: discountCode added to the request; subtotal and discount added to the response.

files.src/contracts/order.contract.ts: Adds optional discountCode to CheckoutRequest; CheckoutResponse gains subtotal and discount.

src/services/discount.service.ts.desc: New service: validates a code (expiry, minimum subtotal) and returns the discount amount.

test/fixtures/orders.fixture.ts.desc: Fixture update only: adds subtotal and discount to mock responses.
